description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailConfigurationAPI' that serves as an API endpoint for managing email configuration settings within an OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and validating email configuration data, and handles related dependencies such as external service calls and data models.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPI
classes.description: A PHP class providing REST API endpoints for managing email configuration settings in the OrangeHRM platform, including retrieving and updating email configurations and performing validations.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EmailConfigurationService used to interact with email configuration data.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance, enabling dependency injection.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the current email configuration. Returns default values if none are set.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, primarily validating the presence of an ID parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update email configuration settings; optionally sends a test email if an address is provided.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating email configuration parameters, including conditional rules based on mail type.

methods.name: getMailTypeDependentRules
methods.description: Constructs validation rules that depend on the mailType and other parameters to enforce conditional validation logic.

methods.name: getSmtpHostRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the SMTP host parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpUsernameRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the SMTP username parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpPasswordRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the SMTP password parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpAuthTypeRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for the SMTP auth type parameter.

methods.name: saveEmailConfigurationInfo
methods.description: Persists the email configuration data, creating a new entity if necessary.

methods.name: setEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Populates an EmailConfiguration entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException indicating delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException as delete validation is not implemented.
